raw.overview: All three advisors unanimously confirm the vendor's Enterprise High-Availability SLA meets both core constraints: the 99.9% uptime guarantee mathematically permits at most 43.2 minutes of monthly downtime (well under the 60-minute US business hours limit), and the breach remedy clause provides a 50% service credit, satisfying the minimum 50% reimbursement requirement. No material issues were flagged across any assessment.
raw.points_of_note: The advisors consistently interpret the 99.9% uptime as permitting 43.2 minutes of monthly downtime (Advisor 1), 7.2 minutes (Advisor 3), or simply as meeting the 60-minute threshold (Advisor 2), with all positions aligning to satisfy the outage limit. All three explicitly note scheduled maintenance occurs exclusively during off-peak UTC hours on Sundays (02:00-04:00 UTC), ensuring zero US business hour outages. Each advisor confirms the 50% service credit for breaches below 99.9% meets the reimbursement threshold, with no constraint violations identified.
raw.suggested_next_step: Proceed with vendor approval as all constraints are fully satisfied by the SLA terms and no material issues were flagged by any advisor.
